title: Number of Sets of K Non-Overlapping Line Segments
description: Find the number of ways to draw k non-overlapping line segments on n points on a 1D line.
pseudocode:
1. dp[n+1][k+1][2] initialized to 0
2. dp[0][0][0] = 1
3. for i from 0 to n:
4.   for j from 0 to k:
5.     for state in {0, 1}:
6.       dp[i+1][j][0] += dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]
7.       if state == 0:
8.         dp[i+1][j+1][1] += dp[i][j][0]
9.       else:
10.        dp[i+1][j][1] += dp[i][j][1]
11. return dp[n][k][0] + dp[n][k][1]

steps.note: Initialize DP table with base case: 0 segments on 0 points = 1 way.
Transitioning for point 1: Adding a non-segment state.
Starting a new segment on point 1.
Continuing an existing segment to point 2.
